title: Sorted product list
summary: Derive a sorted list during render, without mutating props.
prompt: Finish `ProductList`. A "Sort by" select offers "name" and "price", and the list starts sorted by name. Each item reads "Name: $price" with two decimals. Sorting must never reorder the `products` array the parent passed in.
hints: `Array.prototype.sort` sorts in place. Copy first with `[...products].sort(…)`, or use `toSorted`.
Derive the sorted list during render instead of copying it into state.
